verdict.rationale: Workable documents a built-in 'Workable Agent' that takes over sourcing, screening and qualifying candidates and returns a shortlist, plus in-product AI candidate search and recommendations. That is real in-product delegation, but it is limited to top-of-funnel recruiting and backed by a single marketing claim. The MCP server only connects external assistants, so it is not credited as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant or natural-language command surface for delegating arbitrary tasks, in-depth first-party docs on how tasks are assigned to the Agent and controlled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
